# SolveLang

SolveLang is a workflow analysis and automation language for business operations.

SolveLang helps founders, operators, and technical teams turn messy support, client intake, lead routing, approvals, and internal operations into readable workflow blueprints. It makes triggers, business rules, hidden decisions, missing branches, ownership, exceptions, human review points, and safe next actions visible before software runs the workflow.

SolveLang is not a language-learning service, homework solver, translation provider, chatbot directory, or general-purpose AI agent framework.

Agent frameworks and integration platforms can execute model-driven actions or connect applications. SolveLang focuses on the operational layer that should be understood first: why a workflow takes one path instead of another, who owns each handoff, when a person must review the result, and what happens when information is missing or a step fails.

## Available Today

- Open-source Rust CLI
- Local-first Workflow Intelligence Studio
- Deterministic workflow analysis and scenario simulation
- Local traces, analytics, versions, and evidence exports
- Readable SolveLang workflow scripts
- Safe local execution mode
- Source-located validation diagnostics
- Browser-safe preview
- Workflow examples and documentation
- Guided Workflow X-Ray service

## Current Boundaries

- The browser preview is a safe static preview and does not call a server.
- The Workflow Intelligence Studio runs locally and does not send workflow data or analytics externally.
- Studio analysis is deterministic static analysis, not AI analysis.
- Studio-generated SolveLang scripts are drafts; the Rust CLI remains canonical for validation and execution.
- The Rust CLI runtime exists for local validation and execution.
- Full managed automation hosting and production integrations are still evolving.
- SolveLang should not be described as a language-learning tool, general AI solver, or fully hosted enterprise automation platform.

## Main Call To Action

Send one messy workflow for a Workflow X-Ray. SolveLang maps the trigger, decisions, missing branches, ownership, human review points, readable workflow draft, automation path, and setup recommendation.

Contact: hello@solve-lang.com
